/.title: Andiamo in Banca | Award-Winning Italian Dining in SSF
/.description: South San Francisco's premier Italian restaurant in a restored 1920s bank building. Recipient of the 2026 Wine Spectator Award of Excellence. Handmade pasta, curated wines, and The Vault private dining.

/menu.title: Menu & Award-Winning Wine List | Andiamo in Banca
/menu.description: Handmade pasta, fresh seafood, and Italian classics paired with our 2026 Wine Spectator Award of Excellence wine list. Andiamo in Banca, South San Francisco.

/our-story.title: Our Story | Andiamo in Banca
/our-story.description: From Cafe Figaro in 1989 to Andiamo in Banca — the Akkaya family has been feeding the Bay Area for over 35 years. Discover our story.

/the-vault.title: The Vault Private Dining | Andiamo in Banca
/the-vault.description: Host your private event in The Vault — our exclusive dining room inside a restored 1920s bank vault. Pair your event with our Wine Spectator Award of Excellence cellar. South San Francisco.

/private-dining.title: Private Dining & Corporate Events | Andiamo in Banca SSF
/private-dining.description: South San Francisco's most distinctive private dining room with a 2026 Wine Spectator Award of Excellence wine program. Host corporate dinners and board meetings in a restored 1920s bank vault. Walking distance from Genentech and the SSF biotech corridor. 10 minutes from SFO.

/contact.title: Contact & Hours | Andiamo in Banca
/contact.description: Visit us at 301 Linden Ave, South San Francisco. Reservations, hours, and directions for Andiamo in Banca — 2026 Wine Spectator Award of Excellence.

/gallery.title: Gallery | Andiamo in Banca
/gallery.description: Photos of our dining room, dishes, and historic bank building. Andiamo in Banca — South San Francisco.

/private-events.title: Private Events & Private Dining | Andiamo in Banca SSF
/private-events.description: Host private events in a restored 1920s bank — The Vault private dining room, corporate dinners, holiday parties, and rehearsal dinners. Banquet menus from $35/guest, an award-winning cellar, and on-site catering. South San Francisco, minutes from the biotech corridor and SFO.

/banquet-catering.title: Private Event & Banquet Menus, Catering | Andiamo in Banca
/banquet-catering.description: Prix-fixe private event and group dining menus in South San Francisco: $35 lunch, $65, $80 and $120 dinners per guest, wine pairings from $30. The Vault seats 12 to 22; buyouts to 100. Catering delivery through ezCater.

/holiday-parties.title: Holiday Parties for 12 to 100 Guests | Andiamo in Banca
/holiday-parties.description: Holiday parties in a restored 1920s bank in South San Francisco. The Vault seats 12 to 22, the dining room takes up to 100 with no buyout, or close the whole restaurant. Dinner menus at $65, $80 and $120 per guest.

/rehearsal-dinners.title: Rehearsal Dinners | Andiamo in Banca
/rehearsal-dinners.description: Host your rehearsal dinner at Andiamo in Banca. Private dining in The Vault, an award-winning wine program, and an unforgettable setting. South San Francisco.
